findings.title: June30 WB PSM falls outside native ban

findings.title: DIVNFZ second use need not remove growth

findings.impact: One annual removed mow does not establish removal at both uses. An explicitly unremoved second mow outside the rest interval produces no DG-011, despite the source requiring removal or grazing of growth from both uses.

findings.title: DIVNFZ imputes last collection completion from first mowing
findings.source_quote: Der nutzungsfreie Zeitraum beginnt im Fall einer Mahd als erste Nutzung am Tag nach der letzten Überfahrt mit Ladewagen oder nach dem Ballenabtransport.
findings.impact: Missing actual completion is replaced with the first-use date, creating an unverified release date. The probe expects absence of a verified release, not a prediction about an unknown real collection date.

findings.title: Kreislauf grassland double-counts overlapping DIV and species-rich area
findings.impact: The source describes eligible physical area under either criterion. Adding the counters counts an overlapping 1 ha parcel twice: 10% instead of 5% on 20 ha, potentially crossing the strict 8% threshold.

findings.impact: The May 22 notice permits the extra advance only when the comparable second cut occurs or has occurred. Native BIO shifts the guaranteed date to July 1 even with no comparator; its cap can also precede a later actual cut. Assumption A-09 does not match this execution.
